items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I believe that Dan had a brief episode with Corona that was not pleasant at all, so that was sad.

ctx.x: Actually it was very stressful because I had just started a tour. I started the tour on March 1, and I was working January and February in the States. So we did the jazz cruise, we came home, went to San Diego came home, went to Florida came home. So I had a pretty full January and February and actually a pretty full year booked you know. Some of the tours I do in Europe are organized two years in advance. So this particular one in March was two years in the making, which is a lot of phone calls, a lot of emails,…

gigs next week and the week after weren’t cancelled, I cancelled them and they were not happy with me. In fact some of the contracts, some of the promoters were actually saying, “You owe us money.” You know what I mean? “You can’t cancel out of these gigs.” Of course the gig cancelled but I was just ahead, a day ahead even. And I felt bad because I left certain band leaders and promoters in the lurch. I was on the phone for three hours to United trying to get a flight home. I got one via Heathrow, because I…
We met them at the jazz convention in New Orleans, they were doing the Brubeck thing.
